newsitem.title: UK: UK PMI index at s/a 53.4 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: UK PMI index at s/a 53.4 pct in September.

text.p: The UK Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) rose to a seasonally-adjusted 53.4 percent in September, its highest level for seventeen months, from an upwardly revised 52.0 percent in August, the Chartered Institute of Purchasing and Supply (CIPS) said on Tuesday.

"Both output and new order levels recorded the largest monthly increases since the Autumn of 1994 while the quantity of inputs bought by companies showed the first significant monthly increase since April last year," it said in its September survey.

The main source of increase in demand continued to be UK markets. "In particular demand has largely stemmed from rising levels of consumers' expenditure, which has expanded order books and driven up output levels in firms producing consumer goods," it said.

The weakness of worldwide demand continued to influence input prices which fell again. "However, the number of companies reporting a fall in prices dropped to its lowest level since January, causing the price index to move upwards for the second consecutive month," it said.
The prices index read 44.0 in September, up from 41.7 in August.

The survey said while in recent months growth has filtered down to producers who supply components to the consumer sector, in September growth filtered down a further level, to producers of investment goods such as plant machinery.
"These latter producers saw their first significant increase in new orders for a year as companies increased expenditures in order to expand."
However, the survey said although investment in plant and machinery appears to have risen, companies remained reluctant to take on more staff.
The lack of recruitment was, in part, explained by the slow growth in European markets, it said.
Following is a table of seasonally adjusted PMI indices
(previously reported August figures in brackets)
SEPT AUG (pvs)
Purchasing managers' index (PMI) 53.4 52.0 (51.8)
Prices index 44.0 41.7 (41.5)
Output index 57.9 53.6 (53.4)
Suppliers' delivery times index 50.1 50.6 (50.3)
Quantity of purchases index 54.5 50.2 (50.0)
New orders index 56.3 54.8 (54.3)
Stocks of purchases index 45.2 46.9 (47.1)
Stocks of finished goods index 47.6 45.8 (45.1)
NOTE - The PMI is based on a weighted average of seasonally adjusted measures of output, new orders, suppliers' delivery times, stocks of items purchased and employment.
The measures are turned into indices which vary around 50 percent, a level which indicates no change on the previous month.
An index reading below 50 percent indicates a decline compared with the previous month; above 50 percent an increase. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7715
